Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_ManualPress: Builds a manual press for fruit, crop, and sugar wash processing.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_FermentationBarrel: Builds a sealed barrel for fermenting raw mash into fermented wash.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_LiquidBarrelRack: Builds an empty two-barrel liquid container.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_DistillationStill: Builds a heated still for distilling fermented wash into alcohol and ethanol.
Tooltip_craft_IDBFS_IndustrialTank: Builds a large stationary tank for storing one liquid type.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedIngredients: Requires ingredients, a bucket-type container, and water if listed.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NoLiquidItems: No valid liquid containers in inventory.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NoTakeableLiquid: No takeable liquid batch is ready.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedFermentable: Requires at least one raw fermentable liquid batch.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedWine: Requires wine or cider stored in this barrel.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedDistillable: Requires distillable liquid loaded in the still.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedFuel: Requires charcoal, a log, or a plank for heat.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedFireSource: Requires a lighter, matches, firestarter, or blowtorch to ignite.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedEthanol: Requires ethanol stored in this station.
Tooltip_IDBFS_NeedFuelAdditive: Requires vegetable oil or olive oil as additive.
